answers_verified: All 20 stored solutions were re-solved independently from the Chart.js configs (script _verify_L01.py, 31 assertions, 0 failures). Every non multiple-choice walk was checked to land exactly on its stored solution. No stored answer was changed.
misconceptions_note: All 20 original catch-all check:'wrong' misconceptions deleted (several stated the correct answer outright, e.g. bronze[0] 'it reaches 60mm'). Replaced with 40 expect-matched entries, 2 per problem, each derived by committing the named error: axis confusion, off-by-one bar, wrong legend series, adding instead of subtracting, dividing percentage change by the new value, giving the raw increase, reading a stacked bar's starting level instead of its size, giving a value where a time is asked, counting points instead of reading the axis. Multiple-choice expects are distractor indices.
opener_concept: Two bars side by side, drawn as inline SVG: rainfall on Monday (30 mm) and Tuesday (50 mm) on a labelled 0 to 60 scale. Box 1 asks how high Tuesday's bar reaches, answerable by pure common sense with no method taught. Box 2 asks how much more rain fell on Tuesday. The reveal names those two moves, matching a bar top to the side axis and subtracting one reading from another, as the whole of the lesson.
notes: 20/20 problems now carry a hint and guided_steps (including all 6 multiple-choice problems, since each correct option is reachable by reading and calculating; no guided_skip_reason was needed). Every walk's FIRST box locates the student on the stimulus (which bar along, which plotted point, which group, how many points on the line) before any value is read. Completion boundaries (phase:'substitute') are set so locating and scale set-up are pre-worked and the reading-through, calculation and check are live, with 2 or more live boxes in every walk. Added problem_bank.{bronze,silver,gold}_description (geography had none), tier_guides for all three tiers, guided.opener and guided.teach for all three tiers. The three teach walks each carry a self-contained inline SVG stimulus (simple bar chart, dual bar chart, stacked percentage bar) since this lesson has no image URLs to reuse; no URL was invented. All 20 Chart.js stimuli preserved byte-for-byte, along with related_videos, topic_links and worked_examples. method_card slimmed from 5 steps and ~230 words to 4 steps and 108 words. Board-neutral throughout; no em dashes in student-facing text. Validator PASS; live row GET confirms it is byte-identical to the shipped file.
